question: 已发表 MATLAB 参数实验的可认出结论是否依赖 rng(1)；同设计点上认出时间与阶段平均概率的跨种子分布

settings.design_point: published-workspace values, NOT the drifted script text
settings.process_noise_covariance: 1e-6 * diag([140,1000,4,1200,0]) for truth draws and all 12 filter ProcessNoise
settings.candidates: per-parameter lhsdesign(10,1) in cw[300,700]/cv[20,60]/cg[1.5e7,1.9e7]/cq[2,7] + truth phase-1 and phase-2 rows
settings.filters: trackingUKF alpha=0.6874 beta=2 kappa=-2; trackingIMM TransitionProbabilities=0.99, uniform initial
settings.draw_order: mirrors published main_params.m including the four unused dv/dg/hq/hs lhsdesign draws
settings.reduction: IMM loop only; the independent 12-filter ensemble of the published script is not run

seeds.reference: rng(1) not rerun; its anchors come from the published .mat (verified in walrus_imm_alignment_v02)

summary_rules.anchor_code: same implementation as walrus_imm_alignment (_anchor_metrics, git 73916fc): phase1 rows 1-1216 true filter 11, phase2 rows 1217-2433 true filter 12 (1-based); stable-top = argmax stays true until phase end
summary_rules.per_metric_quantiles: min / q25 / median / q75 / max, numpy linear interpolation
summary_rules.censoring: count and fraction of seeds with no stable-top in a phase must be reported alongside quantiles
summary_rules.rng1_position_rule: within [min,max] -> 非异常; outside IQR -> report quantile position; outside [min,max] -> 异常，单实现结论依赖种子. No other tiers may be added post hoc.
summary_rules.id23_bridge: report fraction of seeds with stable-top cycle <= 10 per phase
summary_rules.divergence: seeds with NaN/Inf in imm_probs are reported as-is, never redrawn

outputs.per_seed: seeds/seed_<seed>.mat with imm_probs, cw/cv/cg/cq, seed, qobs, t1_2, t2_3

review.layer_1: design fidelity (driver vs published workspace) + results
review.layer_2: independent anchor recomputation from seed .mat files
